import sys

def find_optimal_reconstruction(fragments):
    n = len(fragments)
    graph = {i: [] for i in range(n)}
    
    # Build the graph
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(n):
            if i != j:
                suffix = fragments[i][-5:]
                prefix = fragments[j][:5]
                if suffix == prefix:
                    graph[i].append(j)
    
    # Find the longest path in the graph
    def dfs(node, visited, path):
        visited[node] = True
        path.append(node)
        
        max_path = path[:]
        for neighbor in graph[node]:
            if not visited[neighbor]:
                result = dfs(neighbor, visited, path)
                if len(result) > len(max_path):
                    max_path = result
        
        path.pop()
        visited[node] = False
        return max_path
    
    longest_path = []
    for i in range(n):
        visited = [False] * n
        path = dfs(i, visited, [])
        if len(path) > len(longest_path):
            longest_path = path
    
    # Check for ambiguity
    if len(longest_path) < n:
        return "AMBIGUOUS"
    
    # Reconstruct the text
    reconstruction = fragments[longest_path[0]]
    for i in range(1, len(longest_path)):
        fragment = fragments[longest_path[i]]
        overlap = len(fragment) - len(fragment.lstrip(fragments[longest_path[i-1]][-5:]))
        reconstruction += fragment[overlap:]
    
    return reconstruction

# Read input
input = sys.stdin.read
data = input().splitlines()
n = int(data[0])
fragments = data[1:]

# Find and print the optimal reconstruction
result = find_optimal_reconstruction(fragments)
print(result)
